SYMPTOM: Next.js build error when using useSearchParams() in a page component
CAUSE: Next.js App Router requires useSearchParams to be wrapped in a Suspense boundary because it's a dynamic hook that can cause hydration issues
FIX: Wrap the component using useSearchParams in <Suspense fallback={...}> in the parent or extract to a child component wrapped in Suspense
PREVENT: Always wrap useSearchParams usage in Suspense — applied this in app/page.tsx for the ?searchId=xxx re-search feature
